messages:
nora: quick flag 1: our recent RBAC audit shows `redwood-ci-sa` still has `cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on prod wrapping key. i thought we gated that to new WIF flow.

felix: agreed, that binding should have been removed after the WIF rollout. can you paste the iam diff?

nora: iam diff snippet: `bindings: - members: serviceAccount:redwood-ci-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`

amy: Are we confident any secrets were decrypted by it? Check KMS audit for Decrypt calls from that SA in the last 72h.

sec-oncall: I'll take lead. Immediate plan: 1) revoke SA keys / disable long-lived tokens 2) run audit query for decrypts 3) if decrypts exist, create new key version + schedule rewrap for affected ciphertexts 4) rotate any Vault transit key if used.

ops-bot: recorded incident SEC-2026-310, priority P2.

felix: query I ran returned 4 Decrypt ops in past 48h from redwood-ci-sa against projects/redwood/locations/us-central1/keyRings/prod-rr/cryptoKeys/secret-wrap. timestamps: 2026-03-21T22:14, 2026-03-22T01:03, 2026-03-22T04:17, 2026-03-22T08:05.

amy: Ok that indicates potential exposure. Next steps: list blobs decrypted (we have audit log entries with resource names). I'll export list to the ticket and mark which secrets to rewrap.

nora: I will temporarily remove the role binding and create a short-lived work-identity for CI pipeline. Also opening PR to stop CI printing wrapped keys to logs (found one echo $WRAPPED_DEK).

sec-oncall: Assignments: nora remove binding + PR, amy export decrypt targets, felix coordinate rewrap + schedule canary rewrap (prefix `secret/data/ci/canary/*`), ops-bot create follow-up alert for SA decrypts >1/day.

felix: canary rewrap plan: 1) create new key version `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=secret-wrap --location=us-central1 --keyring=prod-rr` 2) decrypt old ciphertext -> encrypt with new version for each affected DEK 3) push rotated wrappers back to Vault if applicable. will run with concurrency 5.

amy: note: if transit was used, run `vault write -f transit/keys/secret-wrap/rotate` after KMS rewrap to keep versions consistent. also ensure write access is audited.

sec-oncall: timeline: containment (binding removed + CI creds rotated) done by 10:35 UTC. canary rewrap at 11:00. full bulk in off-peak window tonight. will post status in this thread.

nora: partner teams notified to rotate any pulled artifacts. also adding a lint rule to CI to block `echo $WRAPPED_DEK` and `set -x` in deploy jobs.

felix: canary rewrap finished with 0 errors at 11:14. scheduling bulk at 02:00 with low concurrency.

amy: follow-up items for postmortem: tighten KMS IAM reviews, adopt WIF for CI, add alerting for unusual decrypt patterns, ensure pipeline log redaction.

sec-oncall: containment confirmed. moving to remediation and PM writeup. thanks everyone.
